  SIGNAL      SOURCE          INSTALLED  STEP
  Exceptions  OpenTelemetry   ✓          subscribe to Rails.error
      setup subscribes to Rails.error
  Traces      OpenTelemetry   ✓          dual-ship to Packrat
      already exports OTLP; setup adds Packrat as a second OTLP destination, and the current one
      keeps receiving
  Logs        OpenTelemetry              add the OpenTelemetry logs gems
      setup adds the OpenTelemetry logs SDK
  Replays     Sentry browser             add the Sentry browser SDK
      Packrat accepts Sentry envelopes
